description.text: Established in 1958, Zhejiang A&F University (ZAFU) is a provincial-level key university jointly built by the provincial government and the National Forestry and Grassland Administration. Over the past 60 years, the university has grown to cover three campuses, with a total area of 213 hectares. As a multidisciplinary university, it offers eight discipline classes, with strengths in agriculture, forestry, and the biological environment. Currently, the disciplines of Engineering, Plant & Animal Science, Agricultural Science and Environment/Ecology rank in the top 1% of Essential Science Indicators; ZAFU is now ranked in the National Top 200 Universities according to the Academic Ranking of World Universities。Elementary Chinese Course① Elementary Chinese Language; ② Elementary Listening; ③ Chinese Practical Conversation; ④ Chinese and Handwriting; ⑤ Elementary Reading ComprehensionIntermediate Chinese Course① Intermediate Chinese Language; ② Intermediate Listening & Conversation; ③ Intermediate Reading Comprehension; ④ Practical Writing; ⑤ HSK Integrated Training (Optional)Advanced Chinese Course① Advanced Chinese Language; ② Report & News Reading ; ③ Practical Writing ; ④ Advanced Listening; ⑤ HSK Integrated Training (Optional); ⑥ Chinese History and Culture; ⑦ Drama and Film (Optional) Each semester, the International College of ZAFU organizes language-teaching classes at elementary, intermediate and advanced levels. Students are classified by taking a proficiency test. A class is usually composed of 20-30 students

duration.text: The Chinese Language Program at Zhejiang Agriculture and Forestry University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/In total ￥ 14000 CNY/In total

materials.text: Please bring the original with you when you come to ChinaFor the students who have never studied in China： 1） The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2）Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript 3） Police Certificate within one year 4） Language proficiency certificate 5） Other certificates or documents 6）Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months （ Includes a hair test to prove that the student has no history of drug use） 7） Application Form For School 8） Family Information Form 9） Financial Income Statement 10） A Short Video of Self Introduction 11） Commitment without Drug Use History ( Must be submitted with handwritten signature) 12） Application fee payment certificate. Pay and upload the certificate in the application submission interface, and note the personal information format: name, nationality, passport number, amount 13） Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）

requirements.text: Applicants should be aged between 18 and 28Non-chinese citizens with valid foreign passports who are friendly to China; * Chinese citizens who apply for admission to colleges and universities as foreign students after immigration must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (before January 10 of the year of enrollment) (actual residence abroad for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, Subject to entry and exit signature)
